status: FROZEN BEFORE ANY G2-R SOLVER RUN

problem_unchanged.preprocessing: V2 (194 dimensions), scaler fitted on each validation subset only
problem_unchanged.data: same deterministic nested validation subsets N=100,300,500 (g2/g2_validation_subset_row_ids.json); no resampling
forbidden_and_not_used: change of c, d, kernel, data or preprocessing

dual_problem: min_alpha 0.5 alpha^T H alpha - 1^T alpha  s.t. 0 <= alpha <= c

H_computation.definition: H = S_opp^T M^{-1} S_opp, M = S_ell S_ell^T + d I
H_computation.numerical_method: LU solve of M followed by 2 steps of iterative refinement with long-double residuals; then H <- (H+H^T)/2 (symmetrization recorded)
H_computation.reason: cond(M) reaches ~1e7-1e8; the unrefined Cholesky/LU H differs from the refined H by up to ~5e-7 per entry, which is comparable to the residual threshold. Same mathematical H, computed more accurately; the same H is used by every solver and by the validator.

osqp.package: osqp (installed with permission; only this package)
osqp.solution_handling: raw OSQP alpha is evaluated by the validator; bound violation of the raw alpha is reported; all other certificates are evaluated on alpha projected onto [0,c] (projection reported)

projected_gradient.algorithm: monotone projected gradient with Armijo backtracking along the projection arc

step_rule.q_evaluation: exact for the quadratic: q(alpha+) = q(alpha) + g^T d + 0.5 d^T H d with d = alpha+ - alpha (one Hessian-vector product per trial); g+ = g + H d

projected_gradient.stopping_criterion: natural residual r_inf = max_i |alpha_i - Pi(alpha_i - g_i)| <= 1e-6, evaluated at every accepted iterate
projected_gradient.stagnation_guard: stop if the trial step falls below 1e-30
projected_gradient.hessian_access: only through a callable hvp(x) = H x (dense H is used for the exact model at these sizes)

permutation_retest: N=100, same deterministic permutation rule as G2, with the production solver
n2000_gating: run only if validator audit, OSQP reference and production solver all pass at N=100,300,500

amendments.change: projected_gradient.gradient_refresh_every = 1000 iterations: the analytic gradient g = H alpha - 1 is recomputed from scratch every 1000 iterations to remove drift of the update g <- g + H d. This does not change the algorithm, the step rule, the stopping criterion or the thresholds.
amendments.osqp_amendment: none; OSQP reference already run and evaluated with the settings above (all six problems met the thresholds).
